question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Laughing for about ten minutes / continuous each day / is supposed to be / good for your health.
solution:
The erroneous part is** 'continuous each day'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'continuously every day'** should be used instead of** 'continuous each day'.**
